dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Problem: Regularity-free proof for the ordered removal lemma
dossier_meta.statement_text: It will be interesting to try to obtain a proof for the ordered graph removal lemma that does not go through the strong regularity lemma needed in the current proof.
dossier_meta.context_text: The proofs of the ordered removal lemmas rely on strong variants of the graph regularity lemma, which impose a wowzer-type (tower-of-towers) dependence between the parameters $\delta^{-1}$ and $\varepsilon^{-1}$. Fox gave the first regularity-free proof of the unordered graph removal lemma, though still with tower-type dependence; an analogous approach for the ordered setting remains open.
